## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Coverage

- [ ] Added or updated hardware-isolated regression tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Preserved identity, power, confirmation, and protocol safeguards.
- [ ] Updated relevant user or protocol documentation.
- [ ] Added a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Included no local captures, vendor binaries, or generated artifacts.
